{{Top|leg}}
'''Prost Biulf''' was a [[Dean/Legends|dean]] of the [[Garqi Agricultural University]] on [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]] who remained legendary on the campus for years after leaving his position. During his tenure, an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] delegation was impressed enough by Biulf that they sent a package of [[Bafforr tree|baffor seeds]] to the school, which were planted to create a new grove of trees on the university.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
